steps: A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 1 minutes at a hobbing speed of 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev to produce a 20-degree involute shaped gear, with the component moving along the ConveyorBelt from input to output.

Roughing milling is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 32 minutes using a contour cutting tool path with 5-axis offset at a milling speed of 1500 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, starting with a milled part held on a MobileRobot and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a ConveyorBelt.

Surface Grinding is performed on a Grinding Machines using an Aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev, processing a Planed part on a ConveyorBelt for 15 minutes to produce a Ground part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A wire electrical discharge machining operation is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 15 minutes using a molybdenum wire with pulse on time of 5 microseconds, pulse off time of 100 microseconds, and 2000 pulses per millimeter at a cutting speed of 0.2 mm/min, transforming a shaped part on a conveyor belt into a precision finished drilled component that is then stored on a storage cart.

A turning operation is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 72 minutes using a Carbide turning tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, converting a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 41 minutes at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent being transferred from the ConveyorBelt to the StorageCart.

The shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 49 minutes using a high-speed steel tool, with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 0.5 mm/stroke, transforming a milled part from the MobileRobot into a shaped part that is conveyed to the ConveyorBelt.
A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 17 minutes at a shaping speed of 800 rpm, starting from a broached component on a ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped gear on a StorageCart.

A precision milling operation with vibration damping is performed on a Stewart Platform Mill for 12 minutes, using a 3-axis configuration with a 4-flute end mill to achieve a milling precision of ±0.005 mm, transforming a milled part from a mobile robot into a ground part that exits on a conveyor belt.

The honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 39 minutes to finish a honed cylinder with a 50 mm bore size using a 60 grit honing tool, starting from a honed cylinder on a StorageCart and producing a precision finished part that is then placed on the FinalAssemblyLine.

A tapered broach is used on a Broaching Machine to broach a Metal bar for 66 minutes at a feed rate of 0.08 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 30 mm, resulting in a Broached component that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A CNC Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center using a Standard gear shaft program, with a spindle speed of 800 rpm and a tool offset of 0.02 mm for tool A, processing a lathed part on a ConveyorBelt for 64 minutes to produce a finished machined component of type MilledPart that is transferred to the FinalAssemblyLine.

A vertical milling operation is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 10 minutes using an end mill with 4 flutes at a milling speed of 1800 rpm and a depth of cut of 2 mm, starting with a lathed part held by a mobile robot and ending with a milled part conveyed to the conveyor belt.

A Bandsaw Cutting operation is performed for 24 minutes using a high-toughness carbide blade at 3000 rpm with a cutting width of 15 mm, transforming a Metal Bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed Part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 60 minutes to remove material from a Milled part on a ConveyorBelt, achieving a planing depth of 5 mm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, resulting in a Planed part that is stored on a StorageCart.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 76 minutes using a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 1.2 m/s, and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, transforming sheet metal from a ConveyorBelt into a Finished sheet metal product stored on a StorageCart.

A vertical turning operation is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 72 minutes using a carbide tool at a rotation speed of 500 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, transforming a metal bar from a conveyor belt into a lathed part that is then transferred to a mobile robot.
On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed with an M8 coarse thread screw for 47 minutes to produce a screwed component that is transferred to the FinalAssemblyLine.

Shearing of sheet metal on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 99 minutes at a shear angle of 45 degrees, cutting speed of 2 m/min, using a cold-rolled steel blade, starting with sheet metal on the ConveyorBelt and producing sheared sheet metal on the StorageCart.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 92 minutes using a laser power of 2 kW, a cutting speed of 1.5 m/min, and nitrogen assist, transforming a sheet metal component on a conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal product that is then transferred to the final assembly line.

A shaping operation is performed on a Gear Shaper for 28 minutes to convert a broached component into a shaped spur gear with 48 teeth at a shaping speed of 800 rpm, with the input broached component and output shaped gear both transported on the conveyor belt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 62 minutes using a 12 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 1.2 m/s, and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, starting with a sheet metal component transported by a MobileRobot and ending with a finished cut sheet metal product conveyed to a ConveyorBelt.

A milling operation is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 64 minutes using an end mill with carbide tip at a speed of 1500 rpm and a depth of cut of 2.5 mm, transforming a lathed part conveyed on a conveyor belt into a milled part that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using an aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processing a planed part on a conveyor belt for 95 minutes to produce a ground part that is stored in a storage bin.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 94 minutes to transform a milled part carried by a MobileRobot into a planed part that is conveyed to a ConveyorBelt, with a cut depth of 3.0 mm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 90 minutes using a laser power of 1.5 kW, a cutting speed of 8 m/min, and nitrogen assist at 10 bar, transforming a sheet metal component on the conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal product also conveyed on the conveyor belt.

A wire EDM cutting operation is performed on a shaped part conveyed on a conveyor belt using a molybdenum wire with a pulse duration of 50 ns, peak current of 15 A, and a cutting speed of 0.05 mm/rev, for 28 minutes, to produce a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 49 minutes at a spindle speed of 1800 rpm, a drill size of 8 mm, and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, resulting in a DrilledComponent on the ConveyorBelt.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 78 minutes using a milling speed of 1200 rpm, following a contour milling tool path with 5-axis interpolation to achieve a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a mobile robot.

A Horizontal Turning operation is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 96 minutes using a High-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 750 rpm and a feed rate of 0.12 mm/rev, transforming a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part which is then placed back on the ConveyorBelt.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 45 minutes at a shaping speed of 80 rpm, starting from a broached component carried by a MobileRobot and ending as a shaped gear conveyed to the ConveyorBelt.

On a Horizontal Lathe, a Metal bar is lathed for 43 minutes at a rotation speed of 800 rpm using a High-speed steel cutting tool with a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to produce a Lathed part that is then conveyed out on the ConveyorBelt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 86 minutes using a 10 mm punch size, with a stroke speed of 50 mm/min and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, starting with sheet metal on a ConveyorBelt and resulting in a finished cut sheet metal product being transferred to a MobileRobot.

A tapered broach is used on a Broaching Machine to broach a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt for 15 minutes at a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 15 mm, resulting in a BroachedComponent being conveyed on the same ConveyorBelt.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 1 minutes to transform a Milled part into a Planed part, with a planing depth of 0.5 mm, a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6 μm, and the finished Planed part is conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

The shaping operation is performed on a shaper for 51 minutes using a carbide tool with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 80 mm/min, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and producing a shaped part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A CNC Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 7 minutes using a standard profile program, with tool offsets of ±0.02 mm and a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, transforming a lathed part on the conveyor belt into a finished machined component that is then conveyed out on the conveyor belt.

On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed using an M6 screw with a coarse thread to produce a screwed component, for 95 minutes at a production rate of 10 pieces per minute, with the input part conveyed on a conveyor belt and the output component transferred to a mobile robot.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 80 minutes using a contour cutting path at a milling speed of 1200 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and producing a finished machined component that is then conveyed back to the conveyor belt.

The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using an aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev, processing a planed part on a conveyor belt for 97 minutes to produce a ground part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

The sheet metal is laser cut on the Laser Cutter for 3 minutes at a laser power of 1.5 kW, a cutting speed of 10 mm/s, with nitrogen gas assist, producing a cut sheet metal that remains on the ConveyorBelt.

Wire EDM Cutting is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 74 minutes using a molybdenum wire with a pulse duration of 50 ns, peak current of 15 A, and a cutting speed of 0.1 mm/min, transforming a shaped part carried by a mobile robot into a precision finished part that is transferred to a conveyor belt.

A Bandsaw Cutting operation is performed for 97 minutes on a MetalBar component conveyed on a ConveyorBelt, using a Tungsten carbide blade at 1200 rpm with a cutting width of 20 mm, resulting in a LathedPart that is then conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 70 minutes at a shaping speed of 30 rpm, starting from a broached component on a ConveyorBelt and resulting in a shaped gear transferred to a MobileRobot.

A high-precision milling operation is performed on the Stewart Platform Mills for 89 minutes, using a 5-axis tool setup with a milling precision of ±0.005 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part on the conveyor belt into a ground part that is then conveyed out on the same belt.

A Vertical Lathing operation is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 64 minutes using a Carbide tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, transforming a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part which is then placed back on the ConveyorBelt.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 97 minutes at a hobbing speed of 40 rpm and a feed rate of 0.08 mm/rev using a standard involute profile to produce a hobbied gear, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 40 minutes at a spindle speed of 1000 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is then conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.
A Vertical Milling Machine mills a lathed part for 32 minutes at a speed of 1000 rpm using an end mill with a depth of cut of 3 mm, converting the lathed part into a milled part.

Shearing of sheet metal on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 52 minutes using a high-carbon steel blade at a 45-degree shear angle and a cutting speed of 80 mm/s, starting with sheet metal on the ConveyorBelt and producing sheared sheet metal on the MobileRobot.

The honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 64 minutes to finish a honed cylinder with a 50 mm bore size using a 60 grit honing stone, resulting in a precision finished part that is conveyed out on the ConveyorBelt.
